commits.author: Areeb Gillani
commits.message:
Upgrade to Vert.x 5.1.5 and JDK 25
- vertxVersion 4.5.8 -> 5.1.5, JDK toolchain 17 -> 25, Gradle wrapper 8.3 -> 9.5.1
- io.vertx.core.impl.logging -> io.vertx.core.internal.logging (removed from
  vertx-core in V5, moved to separate vertx-core-logging artifact) - fixed in
  Booster, BoostApplication, HttpServerVerticle, AbstractController,
  AbstractService, BoosterEventBusUtils, CustomCodec, VertxClusterUtils
- io.vertx.core.Launcher moved out of vertx-core into vertx-launcher-legacy-cli
  - added as a dependency, no code change needed (same package/class name)
- HttpServerVerticle: SSLOptions -> ServerSSLOptions for updateSSLOptions()
- VertxClusterUtils: VertxOptions.setClusterManager() removed in V5 - switched
  to Vertx.builder().withClusterManager(...).buildClustered()
- HttpRequest: removed getResponseHandler() (Handler<AsyncResult<Message<T>>>
  callback overloads of EventBus.request/send are gone in V5) - replaced with
  reply(Future<Message<Object>>), same intent via the Future-only API
- README: updated the 4 examples using the old callback-style EventBus calls,
  bumped dependency version snippets to 2.0.0
- settings.gradle.kts: added foojay-resolver-convention for JDK 25 toolchain
  auto-provisioning
- jitpack.yml: JDK 17 -> 25
Version: 1.1.1 -> 2.0.0

commits.author: Areeb Gillani
commits.message:
fix: resolve multiple Boost framework issues
- Fix Vertx instance mismatch: use localVertx for service/HTTP deployments
- Fix method overload collision: include parameter types in cache key
- Fix @Autowired inheritance: traverse class hierarchy for field injection
- Fix codec registration: use concrete types instead of interfaces
- Remove unnecessary vertx field reassignment in HttpServerVerticle

commits.author: Areeb Gillani
commits.message:
Fixed Issues:
- Unsafe Verticle cast - No validation before casting
- GET parameter handling - ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException
- No exception handling in routes - Crashes event loop
- NullPointerException - Missing ServiceUnits config
- Wrong cache key - methodBluePrint uses wrong class name
- Missing HTTP verbs - No PUT, DELETE, PATCH
- Hardcoded content-type - Should be application/json
- Clustered mode error handling - Ignores failures
